title: Orthonormal bases for higher Hilbert spaces
summary: In our previous article [arxiv:2410.05120], we introduced the notion of a finite dimensional 3-Hilbert space, categorifying Baez's 2-Hilbert spaces. In this article, by further categorifying Baez's higher linear algebra, we provide useful tools for working with 3-Hilbert spaces, including, generalized scalar multiplication, orthonormal bases, and unitary adjoints for operators. We use these tools to endow the $\mathrm{C}^*$-3-category of 3-Hilbert spaces with a self-enrichment.
